note: The official BBA Syllabuses 2025-26 state that they apply to candidates admitted in 2025-26 and thereafter, subject to approval. These four supplements complete the remaining 6755 BBA Majors: Entrepreneurship, Design and Innovation; Human Resource Management; Information Systems and Analytics; and Marketing. Each Major has a closed 78-credit Programme-local structure comprising 24 Faculty Core credits and 54 disciplinary credits. EDI students complete three disciplinary electives and must choose at least one of IIMT3627 or IIMT3689. HRM students complete four courses from its eight-course elective pool. ISA contains two explicit either-or core pairs and no separate disciplinary elective pool. Marketing students choose two List A courses and one List B course. Courses are not necessarily offered every year. Language, Common Core, AI literacy and 108 credits of free electives remain outside these supplements because those requirements contain open or placeholder course ranges.
